title: Cost-Per-Wear of Every Garment
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outfit:wear
| stats count as wears, latest(price) as price by item
| eval cost_per_wear=round(price/wears,2)
| sort - cost_per_wear
description: Divides each garment's price by how many times you have worn it, exposing your best and worst buys.
value: Cost-per-wear is the single most useful clothing metric, rewarding versatile staples and shaming impulse buys.
implementation: Ingest outfit wears into `index=personal`; compute cost-per-wear per item.
visualization: Bar chart of cost-per-wear by garment.
grandmaExplanation: It works out how much each item of clothing costs per time you wear it, showing your best buys.
